title_tag.issue: Title tag is missing or non-descriptive.
title_tag.impact: Google doesn't know what your page is about, and customers won't click in search results.

recommendations.med-spa: Add: 'Med Spa in [City] | Botox, Fillers & Facials | [Business Name]'
recommendations.landscaping: Add: '[City] Landscaping & Lawn Care Services | [Business Name]'

meta_description.issue: Meta description is missing or too short.
meta_description.impact: A weak description leads to lower click-through rates. You're losing potential leads to competitors with better 'hooks'.

recommendations.cleaning: Add: 'Reclaim your weekend! Sparkle Clean offers top-rated house cleaning in [City]. Licensed, insured, and 100% guaranteed. Book your free estimate online now!'
recommendations.dental: Add: 'Looking for a gentle dentist in [City]? [Business Name] provides comprehensive dental care for the whole family. Accepting new patients. Call [Phone] today!'
recommendations.default: Add: 'Need expert [Service] in [City]? [Business Name] is your local choice for quality work and reliable service. See our results and book your quote today!'

h1_tag.issue: Primary Heading (H1) is missing or contains no keywords.
h1_tag.impact: The H1 is the strongest on-page signal for Google. Without a keyword-rich H1, ranking in the top 3 is nearly impossible.

recommendations.cleaning: Change H1 to: 'Professional House Cleaning Services in [City]'
recommendations.landscaping: Change H1 to: 'Expert Landscape Design & Maintenance in [City]'
recommendations.default: Change H1 to: '[Main Service] Specialists in [City]'

pagespeed.impact: 40% of users will abandon a site that takes more than 3 seconds to load. You are literally paying for traffic that leaves before the page opens.

recommendations.all: Optimize and compress all homepage images, enable lazy loading, and minimize heavy Javascript execution. Consider a faster hosting provider or CDN.

mobile_ready.impact: 68% of local service searches happen on mobile. If your site is hard to use on a phone, you are losing more than half of your potential business.

recommendations.all: Implement a responsive design framework (like Tailwind or Bootstrap) and ensure 'Tap Targets' (buttons) are at least 48x48px for easy clicking on mobile.

ssl.issue: Website is missing an SSL certificate (Not Secure).
ssl.impact: Browsers like Chrome show a 'Not Secure' warning to users. This kills trust instantly for a service business where you enter someone's home.

recommendations.all: Install a free Let's Encrypt SSL certificate via your hosting provider and force all traffic to HTTPS.

social_proof.issue: No visible customer reviews or testimonials on the homepage.
social_proof.impact: Local customers buy based on reputation. Without proof of your quality, you're just another 'random' company.

recommendations.all: Embed your top 3-5 Google Business Profile reviews directly on your homepage using a widget or custom layout.
